params.name: transa
params.reference:
On entry, `TRANSA` specifies the form of op( A ) to be used in the matrix multiplication as follows:

$$
\mathrm{TRANSA} = \text{'N'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'n'}, \operatorname{op}( A ) = A
$$

$$
\mathrm{TRANSA} = \text{'T'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'t'}, \operatorname{op}( A ) = A^T
$$

$$
\mathrm{TRANSA} = \text{'C'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'c'}, \operatorname{op}( A ) = A^H
$$

params.name: transb
params.reference:
On entry, `TRANSB` specifies the form of op( B ) to be used in the matrix multiplication as follows:

$$
\mathrm{TRANSB} = \text{'N'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'n'}, \operatorname{op}( B ) = B
$$

$$
\mathrm{TRANSB} = \text{'T'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'t'}, \operatorname{op}( B ) = B^T
$$

$$
\mathrm{TRANSB} = \text{'C'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'c'}, \operatorname{op}( B ) = B^H
$$

params.name: M
params.reference: On entry, M specifies the number of rows of the matrix op( A ) and of the matrix C. M must be at least zero.

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, N specifies the number of columns of the matrix op( B ) and the number of columns of the matrix C. N must be at least zero.

params.name: K
params.reference: On entry, K specifies the number of columns of the matrix op( A ) and the number of rows of the matrix op( B ). K must be at least zero.

params.name: A
params.reference: k when `TRANSA = 'N'` or 'n', and is m otherwise. Before entry with `TRANSA = 'N'` or 'n', the leading m by k part of the array A must contain the matrix A, otherwise the leading k by m part of the array A must contain the matrix A.

params.name: lda
params.reference: On entry, `LDA` specifies the first dimension of A as declared in the calling (sub) program. When `TRANSA = 'N'` or 'n' then `LDA` must be at least max( 1, m ), otherwise `LDA` must be at least max( 1, k ).

params.name: B
params.reference: n when `TRANSB = 'N'` or 'n', and is k otherwise. Before entry with `TRANSB = 'N'` or 'n', the leading k by n part of the array B must contain the matrix B, otherwise the leading n by k part of the array B must contain the matrix B.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: On entry, `LDB` specifies the first dimension of B as declared in the calling (sub) program. When `TRANSB = 'N'` or 'n' then `LDB` must be at least max( 1, k ), otherwise `LDB` must be at least max( 1, n ).

params.name: beta
params.reference: On entry, `BETA` specifies the scalar $\beta$. When `BETA` is supplied as zero then C need not be set on input.

params.name: C
params.reference: Before entry, the leading m by n part of the array C must contain the matrix C, except when $\beta$ is zero, in which case C need not be set on entry. On exit, the array C is overwritten by the m by n matrix ( $\alpha$\*op( A )\*op( B ) + $\beta$\*C ).

params.name: ldc
params.reference: On entry, `LDC` specifies the first dimension of C as declared in the calling (sub) program. `LDC` must be at least max( 1, m ).
